d.note: New doors only, every one a **premium flower** seller, and all kept clear of our live accounts. Runs due west then north — **no Long Island leg**, Farmingdale is a backtrack from Long Beach. Amsterdam is the only stop worth making in the four-hour Albany→Syracuse stretch.

Every new premium-flower door around Syracuse that clears our existing accounts — there are only five, so this is a light drive and long conversations. Works north to south and finishes pointing home.
